name: align-content
note: `normal` and baseline alignment are not mapped

name: align-items
note: `normal` is not mapped; `stretch` is the default

name: align-self
note: `auto` and `normal` cannot undo an earlier value
advisory: unsupported value for align-self: auto/normal — cannot undo an earlier align-self (v1)

name: animation-timeline
advisory: `animation-timeline` is not supported (v1) — scroll/view timelines have no clock here; the animation runs on the document timeline instead

name: app-region
note: A window drag region, as in Electron

name: aspect-ratio
advisory: unsupported value for aspect-ratio: auto — cannot undo an earlier ratio (v1)

name: backdrop-filter
advisory: backdrop-filter: only blur() is implemented (v1) — dropped grayscale()

name: background-attachment
note: A background scrolls with its element

name: background-clip
note: Only `text`; the background fills the padding box
advisory: `background-clip` is ignored (v1) — the background always fills the padding box (`padding-box`, the value a rounded box wants anyway)

name: border-collapse
advisory: the table properties are not applied (v1) — `<table>` and friends lay out as plain blocks; build tables out of flex rows or a grid track list, which both render

name: box-shadow
note: A shadow coloured `currentColor`, `light-dark()` or a system colour is dropped
advisory: `box-shadow` value does not resolve to a concrete color (v1) — `light-dark()` and system colors (`Canvas`, `ButtonText`, …) are not computed; write the color, and switch it with `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` where it must follow the theme

name: box-sizing
advisory: `box-sizing: content-box` is not supported (v1) — taffy sizes every box as `border-box`, so padding and border stay INSIDE the declared width/height

name: caption-side
advisory: the table properties are not applied (v1) — `<table>` and friends lay out as plain blocks; build tables out of flex rows or a grid track list, which both render

name: clip
note: Only the empty rect of the visually-hidden idiom
advisory: a non-empty legacy `clip: rect()` is not applied (v1) — it is deprecated in CSS too, and clipping a box to an arbitrary sub-rectangle needs a content mask the paint path does not carry. `clip: rect(0,0,0,0)` (the visually-hidden idiom) IS honoured, and `overflow: hidden` on a sized box clips for real

name: clip-path
note: Basic shapes and `path()`; `url()` is not applied
advisory: `clip-path: url()` is not applied (v1) and the element paints unclipped — `inset()`, `circle()`, `ellipse()`, `polygon()`, `path()` and a box (`padding-box`…) are honoured

name: content
note: A literal string; counters and `attr()` generate nothing
advisory: `content: that value` does not generate a box (v1) — only a literal string does. Counters, `attr()`, `url()` and the `open-quote` family have no model here; render the value as a real element

name: cursor
advisory: `cursor: Wait` has no native platform shape; using the arrow cursor

name: display
note: No line boxes; `contents` and the table values lay out as `block`

name: empty-cells
advisory: the table properties are not applied (v1) — `<table>` and friends lay out as plain blocks; build tables out of flex rows or a grid track list, which both render

name: filter
note: One `blur()`, one `drop-shadow()` and one same-document SVG `url(#id)`; the colour functions are not applied
advisory: `filter`: supported functions are blur(), drop-shadow(), and a single same-document SVG feColorMatrix URL. Blur and drop-shadow require the painted shape described by the render-side advisory — dropped grayscale()

name: font-optical-sizing
advisory: `font-optical-sizing: none` is not applied (v1) — a variable font's `opsz` axis is driven from the font size here, which is what `auto` (the initial value, and what every browser does) asks for. There is no way to switch it off

name: font-variation-settings
advisory: `font-variation-settings` is not applied (v1) — a face is selected through the weight/width/slope model, not by axis value, so an arbitrary axis (`wdth`, `slnt`, a custom one) cannot be instantiated. `font-weight` and `font-style` do reach the axis the WWS model covers, and `opsz` is driven from the font size

name: grid
advisory: unsupported value for grid-template-areas (and the `grid` / `grid-template` shorthands that carry it) — the named grid is not modelled. Declare `grid-template-columns`/`-rows` and place items with `grid-column`/`grid-row` line numbers (v1)

name: grid-area
advisory: unsupported value for grid-area naming a template AREA — `grid-template-areas` is not modelled; the four-line form (`grid-area: 1 / 1 / 3 / 2`) is (v1)

name: grid-column
advisory: unsupported value for grid-column with a NAMED line or area — use line numbers or `span N` (v1)

name: grid-column-end
advisory: unsupported value for grid-row/grid-column with a NAMED line or area — the named grid is not modelled; use line numbers or `span N` (v1)

name: grid-column-start
advisory: unsupported value for grid-row/grid-column with a NAMED line or area — the named grid is not modelled; use line numbers or `span N` (v1)

name: grid-row
advisory: unsupported value for grid-row with a NAMED line or area — use line numbers or `span N` (v1)

name: grid-row-end
advisory: unsupported value for grid-row/grid-column with a NAMED line or area — the named grid is not modelled; use line numbers or `span N` (v1)

name: grid-row-start
advisory: unsupported value for grid-row/grid-column with a NAMED line or area — the named grid is not modelled; use line numbers or `span N` (v1)

name: grid-template
advisory: unsupported value for grid-template-areas (and the `grid` / `grid-template` shorthands that carry it) — the named grid is not modelled. Declare `grid-template-columns`/`-rows` and place items with `grid-column`/`grid-row` line numbers (v1)

name: grid-template-areas
advisory: unsupported value for grid-template-areas (and the `grid` / `grid-template` shorthands that carry it) — the named grid is not modelled. Declare `grid-template-columns`/`-rows` and place items with `grid-column`/`grid-row` line numbers (v1)

name: grid-template-columns
note: `none` cannot undo an earlier track list
advisory: unsupported value for grid-template-columns — `fit-content()`, named lines, a `calc()` breadth with a percentage in it, and a `repeat(auto-fill|auto-fit, …)` next to a track that is not fixed-size (invalid CSS) are not modelled; every track list of lengths, percentages, `auto`, `min-content`, `max-content`, `<flex>`, `minmax()` and `repeat()` (counted or auto) is (v1)

name: grid-template-rows
note: `none` cannot undo an earlier track list
advisory: unsupported value for grid-template-rows — `fit-content()`, named lines, a `calc()` breadth with a percentage in it, and a `repeat(auto-fill|auto-fit, …)` next to a track that is not fixed-size (invalid CSS) are not modelled; every track list of lengths, percentages, `auto`, `min-content`, `max-content`, `<flex>`, `minmax()` and `repeat()` (counted or auto) is (v1)

name: height
note: Intrinsic sizing keywords are ignored; use flex or grid sizing

name: hyphens
advisory: `hyphens: auto` hyphenates only at soft hyphens (`­`), as `manual` does (v1) — there is no hyphenation dictionary

name: line-clamp
advisory: unsupported value for line-clamp: none — cannot undo an earlier clamp (v1)

name: list-style-image
advisory: this list marker is not generated (v1) — the PREDEFINED counter styles (`disc`, `circle`, `square`, `decimal`, `decimal-leading-zero`, and the alpha and roman ones) do generate a real marker box now. A `@counter-style` rule and a `list-style-image` have no model here: the first needs a counter-style engine, the second a raster in the marker box. Pick a predefined style, or render the marker as a real element (a `<span>`, or `::before { content: "…" }`)

name: list-style-type
note: disc, circle, square, decimal, decimal-leading-zero, the alpha and roman styles
advisory: this list marker is not generated (v1) — the PREDEFINED counter styles (`disc`, `circle`, `square`, `decimal`, `decimal-leading-zero`, and the alpha and roman ones) do generate a real marker box now. A `@counter-style` rule and a `list-style-image` have no model here: the first needs a counter-style engine, the second a raster in the marker box. Pick a predefined style, or render the marker as a real element (a `<span>`, or `::before { content: "…" }`)

name: mask
note: `url(#id)` references to an SVG `<mask>` are not applied; fixed-position descendants escape the mask

name: mask-clip
advisory: `mask-clip` other than `border-box` is not applied (v1): the mask is clipped at the border box. Size and position the mask layers to fit instead

name: mask-image
note: `url(#id)` references to an SVG `<mask>` are not applied

name: mask-mode
note: `match-source` is treated as `alpha`; one mode for all layers

name: mask-origin
advisory: `mask-origin` other than `border-box` is not applied (v1): the mask is laid out and clipped at the border box. Size and position the mask layers to fit instead

name: max-height
note: Intrinsic sizing keywords are ignored; use flex or grid sizing

name: max-width
note: Intrinsic sizing keywords are ignored; use flex or grid sizing

name: min-height
note: Intrinsic sizing keywords are ignored; use flex or grid sizing

name: min-width
note: Intrinsic sizing keywords are ignored; use flex or grid sizing

name: mix-blend-mode
advisory: unsupported value for mix-blend-mode (only `normal`, and `plus-lighter` on view transition images) (v1)

name: pointer-events
advisory: unsupported value for pointer-events: visiblePainted — only `none` and `auto` are modelled (SVG-only values have nothing to apply to)

name: resize
advisory: `resize` is not applied (v1) — there is no user-resize affordance on a gpui                      box. A drag handle has to be a real element with a pointer handler

name: tab-size
note: Whitespace is collapsed, so a tab is one space

name: table-layout
advisory: the table properties are not applied (v1) — `<table>` and friends lay out as plain blocks; build tables out of flex rows or a grid track list, which both render

name: text-decoration
note: `none` cannot undo an earlier line; use `text-decoration-line: none`
advisory: unsupported value for text-decoration: none — cannot undo an earlier underline (v1)

name: text-decoration-skip-ink
note: The underline is one unbroken line
advisory: `text-decoration-skip-ink: auto` is not applied (v1) — gpui draws one                      unbroken underline and does not lift it around descenders. `none` (draw it                      straight through) is what it already does

name: text-indent
note: There is no first line to indent; use `padding-left`
advisory: `text-indent` is not applied (v1) — there is no first-line concept in the                      shaper. `padding-left` indents the whole block

name: text-overflow
advisory: unsupported value for text-overflow: clip — cannot undo an earlier ellipsis (v1)

name: text-underline-position
note: The underline is one unbroken line

name: transform
note: 2D only: rotation about the X or Y axis, depth and `perspective()` are not applied
advisory: `transform` supports ordered 2D translate(), rotate(), scale(), skew(), matrix() and `transform-origin` at paint time — dropped rotate3d()/rotateX()/rotateY()

name: user-select
advisory: `user-select: contain` selects like `text` here: a selection that starts inside the element is not kept inside it

name: vertical-align
advisory: `vertical-align` is not applied (v1) — it aligns boxes inside a LINE box, and taffy has no inline formatting context. `align-items` / `align-self` on the flex parent is the equivalent that works

name: -webkit-line-clamp
advisory: unsupported value for line-clamp: none — cannot undo an earlier clamp (v1)

name: width
note: Intrinsic sizing keywords are ignored; use flex or grid sizing
